name: community-standards
description: Community-driven, experimental documentation and reference material for the UAE Open Finance standards. This repository is not official and is used to gather suggestions, trial modern documentation tooling and explore improvements to the Open Finance specifications.

scripts.fetch:all: npm run fetch:orgs && npm run fetch:sectors && npm run fetch:authendpoints && npm run fetch:github && npm run fetch:specs && npm run fetch:postman && npm run build:search
scripts.build: npm run fetch:all && vite-ssg build && node scripts/encode-api-log.mjs && node scripts/minify-dist-json.mjs
scripts.pretest: npm run fetch:specs && npm run fetch:orgs && npm run fetch:postman
scripts.test:fast: node --test --test-concurrency=1 supporting/tests/api-log-merge.test.mjs supporting/tests/api-log-shards.test.mjs supporting/tests/api-spec-pages.test.mjs supporting/tests/chargeable-endpoints.test.mjs supporting/tests/code-group-language-coverage.test.mjs supporting/tests/endpoint-spec-references.test.mjs supporting/tests/jira-forms-auth.test.mjs supporting/tests/link-integrity.test.mjs supporting/tests/no-uppercase-image-extensions.test.mjs supporting/tests/orphan-pages.test.mjs supporting/tests/page-titles.test.mjs supporting/tests/postman-collection.test.mjs supporting/tests/robots-noindex.test.mjs supporting/tests/sandbox-onboarding-validation.test.mjs supporting/tests/sitemap.test.mjs supporting/tests/spec-to-workbook.test.mjs supporting/tests/specs.test.mjs supporting/tests/ssg-dynamic-routes.test.mjs supporting/tests/unused-components.test.mjs supporting/tests/user-journey-initial-data.test.mjs supporting/tests/version-dropdown-coverage.test.mjs supporting/tests/version-tour.test.mjs
